g.text: SD11 — Move to an Adjacent Location through a Locked Door (UC06, F06; Command, Observer)
(n1) proposal = new ActionProposal(MOVE, "Tool Shed", null); a typed "go east" arrives through SD02 with target "east"
(n3) the command keeps door and key in its exit and key fields for execute()
(n4) invalid if door is null (no exit that way, or the destination is not adjacent: the exits are listed), or the door is locked and key is null ("You need the shed key.")
(n5) text = the results' messages, e.g. the shed's description, items, NPCs and exits (no LLM)
SD03 — mode check: allows(MOVE) is false in combat and dialogue
SD03 — the MOVEMENT event is published (SD05):
SwingGameView.onEvent() calls refresh(), which redraws the map
